audio_description:
Balamb Garden's dome wedged against the red Galbadia Garden.
The two structures stay locked together.

context.scene_title: Battle of the Gardens — the two Gardens locked together over the landscape (Disc 2).
locations: The exteriors of Balamb Garden (tiered grey dome) and Galbadia Garden (red), jammed together beside cliffs
context.summary: Close exterior views show Balamb Garden's tiered dome wedged against the red bulk of Galbadia Garden as the two enormous structures remain locked together during the battle.
